item.text:
**7B.7 Research Note**

Bottom line: I found some real warning signs around concealment and inquiry resistance, but not a clean case that Scholz in 2024 systematically used state power to crush investigators, courts, prosecutors, auditors, or the media. The strongest negatives are the Cum-Ex/Warburg inquiry controversy and Germany’s weak intelligence oversight framework, while the strongest positives are his public openness to press scrutiny and repeated defense of investigative journalism.

**Evidence for tolerance of scrutiny / against concealment**
- [Investigative reporting and critical distance are essential to democracy](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636) | Bundesregierung | 4 Jun 2024 | Scholz publicly praised free, independent, diverse media and said investigative reporting and critical distance are essential to democracy, which cuts against a pattern of silencing or punishing investigators. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Summer press conference with Federal Chancellor Scholz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz spent almost two hours answering journalists’ questions in public, which is ordinary accountability behavior rather than insulation from scrutiny. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [A scoop by nonprofit Correctiv sparked huge pro-democracy protests all over Germany. How did they pull it off?](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/scoop-nonprofit-correctiv-sparked-huge-pro-democracy-protests-all-over-germany-how-did-they) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 5 Apr 2024 | The Reuters Institute reported that Scholz amplified Correctiv’s anti-far-right investigation, showing support for investigative journalism rather than hostility toward it. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Germany would not accept foreign spying and wanted those responsible put on trial](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540) | Reuters via Investing.com | 24 Apr 2024 | Scholz framed the response to suspected spying as prosecution under law, while avoiding prejudgment, which is due-process language rather than intimidation or cover-up. | QIDs: 7B.7
- [Strafanzeigen gegen Mitglieder der Bundesregierung](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1014366) | Deutscher Bundestag | 31 Jul 2024 | The Bundestag said several criminal complaints against Scholz and other ministers did not lead to investigations because there were no sufficient factual grounds, undercutting claims of proven obstruction or criminal concealment. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Germany would not accept foreign spying and wanted those responsible put on trial](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540) | Reuters via Investing.com | 24 Apr 2024 | This also supports the narrower point that Scholz publicly accepted legal scrutiny and prosecution as the proper channel, rather than personal retaliation. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6

**Evidence for concealment / accountability avoidance**
- [Geheimes Kanzleramts-Gutachten in Cum-ex-Affäre: Scholz darf weiter in Deckung bleiben](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | The report said the Chancellery produced a legal memo aimed at undermining a Bundestag inquiry into the Warburg affair, which is the strongest direct sign of trying to blunt scrutiny around a conflict-of-interest allegation. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Cum-Ex: Scholz vor U-Auschuss - erinnert er sich heute?](https://www.zdfheute.de/politik/deutschland/scholz-cum-ex-ausschuss-100.html) | ZDFheute | 6 Dec 2024 | Scholz again said he could not remember the content of meetings with the Warburg bank chief, which sustains suspicion that he was avoiding a full accounting of politically sensitive contacts. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Cum-Ex-Untersuchungssausschuss Chaos hinter den Kulissen](https://www.tagesschau.de/investigativ/ndr-wdr/cum-ex-scholz-untersuchungsausschuss-100.html) | tagesschau.de | 5 Dec 2024 | The report said there were hints of political proximity to the private bank but no proof of influence, while also noting repeated “memory gaps,” which leaves a credibility cloud rather than a proven cover-up. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [The Federal Intelligence Service’s powers to conduct strategic surveillance of international telecommunications for the purpose of detecting cyber threats are unconstitutional in part](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The Court found parts of the BND surveillance regime unconstitutional and said independent oversight was inadequate, which is structural counterevidence that weakens confidence in clean accountability controls under Scholz. | QIDs: 7B.7; 7B.6
- [Insider - Regierung entscheidet "in Kürze" über Sicherheit im 5G-Netz](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | Sensitive 5G-security decisions were handled in confidential interministerial talks and ministries declined public comment, which is a transparency weak point, though not proof of self-serving concealment. | QIDs: 7B.7

**Search gap**
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Scholz ordered prosecutors to be used against critics, fired auditors for doing their jobs, or directly censored media or whistleblowers.
- The strongest negative evidence is indirect or structural: the Warburg/Cum-Ex inquiry controversy, the secret Chancellery legal memo, confidential handling of 5G policy, and the BND oversight ruling.
